correctness.rationale: Every total Roman function belongs to exactly one center-label case. For center label 2, the only extra condition is a nonempty positive periphery; for center label 1, each blade must defend its own zeros; for center label 0, each blade must also avoid singleton positive support and the center requires a peripheral 2. These necessary-and-sufficient conditions yield the displayed polynomial. The minimum-layer argument is exact, and an independent brute-force checker matches all coefficients on six instances.

value.rationale: The arbitrary heterogeneous blade-size family is natural and contains standard windmills and friendship graphs. The theorem gives the complete weight distribution and all minimum functions, not a routine substitution into a known family formula; its center-state factorization records a structural interaction between a cut vertex, clique blades, Roman defense, and the no-isolated-positive condition.
